title: finding(tests): `check-unused-dependencies.test.ts` whole-repo scan flakes on the 15s default `testTimeout` under container load
body:
Observation-class, found while running the gate list for objectui#8274 (PR on `claude/issue-8274-dist-pins-guard-message`). Not fixed there — a different file and a different claim. ⛔ Not claimed.

## What was measured

`scripts/__tests__/check-unused-dependencies.test.ts` → `this repository > is green: every gated declaration has a consumer` runs a whole-repo `analyze(repoRoot)` scan inside a test that declares **no** per-test timeout, so it inherits the root config's `testTimeout: 15000`.

Two runs of `pnpm exec vitest run scripts/__tests__/` on the same tree, same head, exit codes captured by redirect before any pipe:

```
run 1  suite duration  88.04s   121 files passed, 3580 tests passed   exit 0
run 2  suite duration 191.11s   1 file failed                          exit 1
       × is green: every gated declaration has a consumer  16037ms
       Error: Test timed out in 15000ms.
```

In isolation the same file is green and the whole file takes 21.65s of test time across 37 tests:

```
$ pnpm exec vitest run scripts/__tests__/check-unused-dependencies.test.ts
Test Files  1 passed (1)     Tests  37 passed (37)     exit 0
```

The only variable between run 1 and run 2 was machine contention — this container runs several agents in parallel.

## Why it is worth recording

The test's own runtime sits close to its budget: one assertion doing a full-repo scan against a 15s default. It is not slow because it is broken; it is slow because of what it measures. That makes it a load-sensitive flake, and CI runners are exactly where load varies. A red here reads as "an unused dependency was declared", which is a real and alarming verdict — so the cost of the flake is not just a re-run, it is a re-run after someone goes looking for a dependency defect that is not there.

Not verified: whether this has already flaked in CI. Nothing was searched in the Actions history.

## Suggested shape of a fix

Give the whole-repo assertion an explicit per-test timeout sized to what it actually does, rather than letting it inherit a default chosen for ordinary unit tests. Whether the scan itself should also be made cheaper is triage's call.

Refs: objectui#8274 (where this surfaced)
